notes: Runtime identification uses the exact local G-ASCII F/SVFW fingerprint, not the commercial model name.
Captured GPDAT0 and GPV responses match the existing EyeBond G-ASCII telemetry decoder.
Charging-priority CPR03 and CPR00 writes received ACK responses in a SmartValue proxy capture.
The family protocol document describes additional commands, but unverified model-specific writes are not promoted to tested support.

known_limitations: Only charging priority is exposed as a model-verified control.
CPR01 and CPR02 are document-backed members of the verified CPR command family, but the supplied trace directly captured ACK only for CPR00 and CPR03.
Output-priority OPR is intentionally omitted until an ACK and resulting behavior are verified on this exact model.
The original Cloud + HA probe timeout was reported on 0.3.0-beta.1; release retesting is still required against the current connection lifecycle.
knowledge_summary: Gootu GT-H2436M14P5 is a 24V 3.6kW hybrid inverter observed behind an EyeBond Wi-Fi collector. A support archive and SmartValue proxy capture establish the EyeBond G-ASCII telemetry family, the exact 230V/15A/24V/50Hz plus SVFW 4.007 offline fingerprint, and acknowledged CPR00/CPR03 charging-priority writes. The exact runtime profile therefore reuses the established telemetry decoder and exposes only the evidence-backed charging-priority control.
